experiment: E10 and E11, the chart that tells the truth

machines.new: M + the branch built for the level of the test
machines.old: M + the branch built at level 0 (the partner of E8)

T1.rule: at v = 25 the median share of the push the branch removes is within [0.9, 1.1] at level 0 and falls as the level grows

T2.rule: at v = 25 and levels 0.5 and 1, |share removed - excess of the theorem|, median over the units, is at most 0.1

T3.rule: at v = 100 and level 0.5 the median of share removed minus excess is above 0.2: the theorem's excess does not describe the branch there (an expectation taken from old data)

T4.rule: at v = 25 and level 0.5 the tuned pair with the partner built for the level is more sensitive than the tuned pair with the soloist: interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

T5.rule: at v = 25 and level 1.5, at face value, (pair with the partner - pair with the soloist) / pair with the soloist is in the median within +-0.03

T6.rule: at v = 25 and every level the tuned pair (H, M + R_d) over the tuned pair (C_d, M) is in the median at most 1.05

X1.rule: at v = 25 and level 1, at face value, the pair with M + R_1 is more sensitive than the pair with M + R_0: interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

X2.rule: at v = 25 and level 1.5, at face value, the pair with M + R_0 is less sensitive than the pair with M: interval below zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

X3.rule: at v = 25 the median difference at face value between new and old is positive at levels 0.5, 1 and 1.5 and grows with the level

X4.rule: at v = 25 and levels 0.5 and 1 the tuned pairs with new and old differ in the median, in absolute value, by at most 0.02 of the second

X5.rule: at v = 100 and level 1, at face value, the pair with M + R_1 is more sensitive than the pair with M + R_0: interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5
